summary: Route Mode slice 3. The algorithm core of the prerequisite map, as two pure modules that are not wired into the app yet: app/pathgraph.py (validate and repair an AI-proposed concept graph, layers, per-branch progress from explicit feedback, smooth deterministic exploration share) and app/pathgrowth.py (assign papers to concepts, corpus support for edges, gap terms, and proposals of new branches with evidence gates and a strength score; merging only ever adds a proposed concept). An independent review found 11 defects, all fixed with tests.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode, on top of b88fe11. Nothing is wired into the app, so no user-visible behaviour changes. The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: Pure local functions: no model call, no network, no clock, no randomness.
budget_impact.before: No prerequisite graph, no per-branch progress, no branch growth.
budget_impact.after: Tested algorithm core, unused by the app until slices 4-6.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

reviews.reviewer: One separate read-only code-review agent (same model family, not a human); 11 findings fixed afterwards, fixes not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: All thresholds (0.6 mastery, 0.35 gain/low interest, 0.10-0.50 exploration, 0.25 strength, 3/2/2 gates, +-0.15 support) are unvalidated proposals; the evaluation baselines are saturated, so no improvement can be claimed.
The independent review was by an agent of the same model family; its 11 findings were fixed and the fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.
Cluster names are a heuristic (leading title phrase); the specialisation rule (cluster inside a concept 1.5x larger) is a judgement call.
Not exercised on real project data; edge support uses only title and abstract text.
Slices 4-8 (project-scoped map storage, AI plan operation needing owner approval, runtime use, growth UI, governance) are not done.
